content.description: Allow production deployments for agents at scope 3 or higher. Agent has earned full deployment privileges.
Allow ProposeChanges actions at scope level 2 or higher. Agents can draft deployment plans and rollback strategies.
Allow ReadPipelineStatus at scope 1 or higher. Low-risk read-only action.
Allow StagingDeployment actions at scope level 3 or higher. Agents can deploy to staging and run integration tests.
Catch-all: deny any action not explicitly allowed by a higher-priority rule. Fail-safe default.
Deny production deployments for agents below scope 3. Production access must be earned through demonstrated safe behavior.
Deny ProposeChanges for agents below scope 2. Proposing changes requires elevated trust.
Deny StagingDeployment for agents below scope 3. Staging deploys require scope 3 or higher.
Staging deployments require human approval. Developer must confirm before agent deploys to staging environment.
